name: 2014 Srinagar Jhelum Flood Inundation

detections.evidence: Water fraction exceeds historical baseline by +184.2%; major submergence along Jhelum river banks.
42.6% of built-up urban structures detected within high-water boundary footprint.

authority_alert: CRITICAL DISASTER NOTICE: Widespread Severe Flood Inundation identified across Srinagar/Jhelum Basin (34.0836°N, 74.8378°E). Standing surface water covers 58.4% of monitored scene with severe residential infrastructure submergence. Immediate evacuation & SDRF asset deployment recommended.

exposure.note: Dense urban clusters submerged along Rajbagh, Jawahar Nagar, and Dal Lake perimeter.

limitations: Turbid flood waters with suspended silt may exhibit spectral properties intermediate between water and wet soil.
Cloud shadows over urban areas can cause minor water misclassification; verified via NDWI spectral threshold.
